<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

In `LocalQueueReconciler.Update`, the conditional block that clears or updates local queue resource metrics is moved to execute after the stop-policy/cache/queue-manager update switch. A unit test is added to verify that the `LocalQueuePendingWorkloads` gauge series is cleared when the queue's labels change from matching to non-matching the metrics selector.

## Changes

**LocalQueue metrics clear race fix**

| Layer / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Reorder metrics clear after manager/cache update** <br> `pkg/controller/core/localqueue_controller.go` | The local-queue metrics update/clear block is moved from before to after the stop-policy/cache/queue-manager switch in `LocalQueueReconciler.Update`, with a comment explaining this prevents a race with concurrent metric reports. |
| **Unit test: metrics cleared on label selector change** <br> `pkg/controller/core/localqueue_controller_test.go` | Adds `TestLocalQueueUpdateClearsMetricsOnLabelChange` with updated imports; pre-populates a `LocalQueuePendingWorkloads` gauge, fires a typed update event simulating a label change, and asserts series clearance on selector mismatch and preservation otherwise. |

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~10 minutes
